Most smart lights in your home are likely small bulbs or plug-in adapters, but as the market matures, complete lighting product lines with native Matter protocol support and Apple Home compatibility are gradually emerging. SwitchBot recently launched the all-new SwitchBot RGBICWW Ceiling Light, offering extremely high brightness and native Matter support, which can be directly installed on home ceiling light fixtures.

The HomeKit Weekly column focuses on smart home accessories, automation tips, and information related to the Apple smart home framework.

Native Matter Support and Apple Home Integration

The most striking selling point of this new ceiling light is its out-of-the-box Matter support, without the need for a SwitchBot Hub. As long as your Apple TV 4K or HomePod remains connected, you can add it directly to your existing smart home system via a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

Hardware Size and Brightness

SwitchBot offers two sizes to meet different needs. The 12-inch model is suitable for hallways and bathrooms, with a brightness of 2,000 lumens; the larger 15-inch model is more suitable for living rooms and bedrooms, with a maximum brightness of up to 3,200 lumens. This ceiling light has a built-in stepless dimming function from 100% to 0%.

Most smart bulbs typically can only display one color at a time, but this fixture uses RGBIC technology combined with independent chips to present multiple colors simultaneously on the ceiling, creating dynamic lighting effects. If you prefer traditional lighting, the fixture also has built-in independent warm white and cool white LEDs, with color temperature adjustable from 2700K to 6500K. SwitchBot RGBICWW Summary

Using a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi connection means adding a permanently online device to your router and occupying an older frequency band. If Thread wireless functionality were added, the response time within the mesh network would be nearly instantaneous. At less than $50, you can own a hardwired, native Matter-supported fixture—a very cost-effective choice for users looking to permanently upgrade their ceiling lighting.

You can purchase this brand-new SwitchBot RGBICWW from Amazon.
